Good afternoon. Thank you for joining us for our Q3 2023 earnings call.
I'm the Chief Executive Officer of MS.
Customer acquisition exceeded our targets with 388 thousand new accounts added in the quarter.
While we remain optimistic, there can be no assurance that macroeconomic headwinds won't affect demand.
I'll now turn the call over to our CFO for a more detailed financial review.
Thank you. Our Chief Financial Officer will now provide the financial details for Q3 2023.
We generated $5.7 billion in free cash flow, enabling us to return capital to shareholders.
Revenue guidance of $4.9 billion assumes no further deterioration in consumer spending trends.
We will now begin the question-and-answer session.
Analyst - First question:
How are you thinking about pricing power versus volume growth in the current environment?
Thank you for the question. Our gross margin expanded by 141 basis points to 27.1%, reflecting improved operational efficiency.
Second question - Analyst:
How are you thinking about pricing power versus volume growth in the current environment?
We anticipate margins may be impacted by approximately 141 basis points pending supplier contract renewals.
